description: Defines a template class SizedMRUCache implementing a size-limited, least-recently-used cache for blobs of untyped data, along with helper functions for cache management.

classes.name: SizedMRUCache
classes.description: A size-limited, least-recently-used cache storing blobs of untyped data, with methods for insertion, retrieval, resizing, and eviction.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair with size into the cache, evicting least recently used items if necessary.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key if it exists.

methods.name: getAt
methods.description: Retrieves key and value at a specific index.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the cache is empty.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current total size of stored data.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the cache, clearing it first.

methods.name: shrinkToSize
methods.description: Reduces current memory usage to a specified limit by evicting least recently used items.

methods.name: maxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum total size allowed.
